decisions.decision: Counselling rule (rule 7) must live in MongoDB agent instructions, not YAML systemPrompt
decisions.rationale: YAML systemPrompt was always broken (wrong indentation causing parse failure). LibreChat uses agent instructions from MongoDB agents collection as the authoritative prompt source.

decisions.decision: Removed systemPrompt block from librechat.yaml entirely
decisions.rationale: It was at wrong indentation (6 spaces after balance: section), invalidating entire YAML parse. Agents store their own instructions in MongoDB — the YAML field was dead code.

decisions.decision: Image Search preset added back to YAML modelSpecs as preset 6
decisions.rationale: Was hidden when YAML fix enabled enforce:true — previously modelSpecs was being ignored due to parse failure, so all agents showed. Now explicitly listed.
